nameForms.name: Duchy of Poland
nameForms.note: The early Piast polity was ruled by dukes before the first royal coronation.
nameForms.noteCn: 早期皮雅斯特政权由公爵统治，直至首次王室加冕。

nameForms.name: Kingdom of Poland
nameForms.note: The royal title was established in 1025, though it was not continuously held after the dynastic crises of the eleventh century.
nameForms.noteCn: 王号于 1025 年确立，但在十一世纪王朝危机后并未持续由统治者持有。

nameForms.name: Fragmented Polish principalities
nameForms.note: The seniorate centered on Kraków gave leading Piast dukes precedence without restoring a unified crowned monarchy.
nameForms.noteCn: 以克拉科夫为中心的最高公爵制赋予皮雅斯特诸公爵优先地位，但并未恢复统一的加冕王国。

nameForms.name: Kingdom of Poland
nameForms.note: Przemysł II restored the royal title; subsequent claims were shaped by rivalry among Piast and Bohemian rulers.
nameForms.noteCn: 普热梅斯瓦夫二世恢复王号；其后的主张受皮雅斯特与波希米亚统治者竞争塑造。

holders.note: Mieszko I established the first well-attested Piast rulership.
holders.noteCn: 梅什科一世建立首个有充分记载的皮雅斯特统治。

holders.note: Succeeded Mieszko I and prepared the elevation to kingship.
holders.noteCn: 继承梅什科一世，并促成王号的提升。

holders.note: First Piast ruler crowned King of Poland.
holders.noteCn: 首位加冕为波兰国王的皮雅斯特统治者。

holders.note: Succeeded Bolesław I and retained the crown until the 1031 crisis.
holders.noteCn: 继承波列斯瓦夫一世，持有王冠至 1031 年危机。

holders.note: Seized rule during the dynastic and foreign intervention crisis.
holders.noteCn: 在王朝与外来干预危机中夺取统治权。

holders.note: Returned to rule but accepted ducal status after partition.
holders.noteCn: 复位后接受分割，并以公爵身份统治。

holders.note: Rebellion, foreign invasion and exile interrupted effective central rule.
holders.noteCn: 叛乱、外来入侵与流亡使有效的中央统治中断。

holders.note: Restored Piast rule without reviving the royal crown.
holders.noteCn: 恢复皮雅斯特统治，但未恢复王号。

holders.note: Succeeded Casimir I as duke.
holders.noteCn: 以公爵身份继承卡齐米日一世。

holders.note: Restored the royal title before losing the throne in crisis.
holders.noteCn: 恢复王号，但在危机中失去王位。

holders.note: Succeeded his brother and ruled without restoring the crown.
holders.noteCn: 继承其兄，且未恢复王号。

holders.note: Conflict between Władysław Herman's sons preceded Bolesław III's sole rule.
holders.noteCn: 瓦迪斯瓦夫一世之子间的冲突先于波列斯瓦夫三世的单独统治。

holders.note: His testament created the seniorate and hereditary district system.
holders.noteCn: 其遗嘱创建最高公爵制与世袭分封制度。

holders.note: First senior prince after the division of 1138.
holders.noteCn: 1138 年分裂后的首位最高公爵。

holders.note: Succeeded after Władysław II's exile, preserving the seniorate without reunification.
holders.noteCn: 瓦迪斯瓦夫二世流亡后继任，维持最高公爵制但未实现统一。

holders.note: First Kraków tenure of Mieszko III.
holders.noteCn: 梅什科三世首次掌握克拉科夫。

holders.note: Took Kraków, shifting the seniorate toward a hereditary political base.
holders.noteCn: 取得克拉科夫，使最高公爵制转向更具世袭性的政治基础。

holders.note: Briefly recovered Kraków during the succession struggle.
holders.noteCn: 在继承斗争中短暂收复克拉科夫。

holders.note: Returned to Kraków and held it until his death.
holders.noteCn: 重返克拉科夫并持有至去世。

holders.note: First period of Leszek I's Kraków seniorate.
holders.noteCn: 莱谢克一世首次掌握克拉科夫最高公爵位。

holders.note: Returned once more to Kraków.
holders.noteCn: 再次重返克拉科夫。

holders.note: Recovered Kraków for a second period.
holders.noteCn: 第二次收复克拉科夫。

holders.note: A final brief restoration before his death.
holders.noteCn: 去世前最后一次短暂复位。

holders.note: Succeeded Mieszko III in Kraków while retaining his Greater Polish base.
holders.noteCn: 在克拉科夫继承梅什科三世，同时保有大波兰根基。

holders.note: Returned to Kraków during the continuing seniorate contest.
holders.noteCn: 在持续的最高公爵争夺中重返克拉科夫。

holders.note: The Kraków seniorate changed hands amid competing Piast claims.
holders.noteCn: 克拉科夫最高公爵位在竞争的皮雅斯特主张间易手。

holders.note: His assassination at Gąsawa accelerated the decline of the all-Polish seniorate.
holders.noteCn: 其在冈萨瓦遇刺，加速了全波兰最高公爵制的衰落。

holders.note: Returned to Kraków after Leszek I's assassination.
holders.noteCn: 莱谢克一世遇刺后重返克拉科夫。

holders.note: A Masovian Piast claimant who held Kraków briefly.
holders.noteCn: 短暂掌握克拉科夫的马佐夫舍皮雅斯特主张者。

holders.note: The most successful Silesian Piast consolidator before the Mongol invasion.
holders.noteCn: 蒙古入侵前最成功的西里西亚皮雅斯特整合者。

holders.note: Succeeded Henry I but died fighting the Mongols at Legnica.
holders.noteCn: 继承亨利一世，但在列格尼察抗击蒙古军时战死。

holders.note: Recovered Kraków after Henry II's death, but only briefly.
holders.noteCn: 亨利二世死后收回克拉科夫，但统治短暂。

holders.note: Provided a long period of Kraków stability without restoring a united kingdom.
holders.noteCn: 在未恢复统一王国的情况下，为克拉科夫带来长期稳定。

holders.note: Held Kraków through collateral Piast kinship.
holders.noteCn: 经旁系皮雅斯特亲属关系掌握克拉科夫。

holders.note: Used Kraków as the base for a failed reunification and coronation project.
holders.noteCn: 以克拉科夫为基础推动未成功的统一与加冕计划。

holders.note: Henry IV's death opened a contest for Kraków rather than a settled dynastic succession.
holders.noteCn: 亨利四世去世后，克拉科夫进入争夺，而非稳定的王朝继承。

holders.note: Restored the royal title, but his assassination left the crown briefly suspended.
holders.noteCn: 恢复王号，但其遇刺使王冠短暂悬置。

holders.note: After Przemysł II's assassination, no single Piast succession secured the crown; Wenceslaus II gained Kraków before his coronation.
holders.noteCn: 普热梅斯瓦夫二世遇刺后，没有单一皮雅斯特继承人稳固王冠；瓦茨拉夫二世先取得克拉科夫，后获加冕。

holders.note: After Przemysł II's murder, Wenceslaus II expanded from his Kraków base and outmanoeuvred the rival Piast claimant Władysław I. He was crowned King of Poland at Gniezno in 1300.
holders.noteCn: 普热梅斯瓦夫二世遇刺后，瓦茨拉夫二世以克拉科夫为基础扩张，并压倒了竞争的皮雅斯特继承人瓦迪斯瓦夫一世。他于1300年在格涅兹诺加冕为波兰国王。

holders.note: Inherited his father's Polish crown, but was assassinated before he could consolidate it.
holders.noteCn: 继承父亲的波兰王冠，但在巩固统治前即遭刺杀。

holders.note: Recovered Kraków and reunited the core Polish lands before restoring the royal title.
holders.noteCn: 收复克拉科夫并重新统一波兰核心领土，随后恢复王号。

holders.note: Crowned at Kraków in 1320, restoring the Polish kingdom.
holders.noteCn: 1320 年在克拉科夫加冕，恢复波兰王国。

holders.note: Succeeded his father and consolidated the reunited kingdom through diplomacy, reform and expansion.
holders.noteCn: 继承父亲，并以外交、改革和扩张巩固重建后的王国。

holders.note: Succeeded Casimir III under the Angevin succession agreements, joining Poland to Hungary in personal union.
holders.noteCn: 依安茹继承安排继承卡齐米日三世，使波兰与匈牙利形成共主邦联。

holders.note: The Polish lords negotiated the succession after Louis I's death.
holders.noteCn: 拉约什一世去世后，波兰贵族就继承问题进行协商。

holders.note: Jadwiga was crowned as king in her own right, establishing her independent royal authority.
holders.noteCn: 雅德维嘉以自身权利加冕为国王（女王），确立独立的王权。

holders.note: Marriage to Jadwiga and his coronation made Jogaila Władysław II, beginning the Polish–Lithuanian union.
holders.noteCn: 与雅德维嘉的婚姻及其加冕使雅盖沃成为瓦迪斯瓦夫二世，开启波兰—立陶宛联合。

holders.note: After Jadwiga's death, Władysław II continued as king and maintained the union with Lithuania.
holders.noteCn: 雅德维嘉去世后，瓦迪斯瓦夫二世继续为王，并维持与立陶宛的联合。
